mapper.select: SELECT i.id as mid, i.status as status, i.update_time as time, i.imgs_url as imgs_url, i.cover as cover, i.content, i.agree_count, i.comment_count, a.id as album_id, a.name as album_name, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS username, u.avatar AS avatar, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_agree_collect ac WHERE ac.agree_collect_id = i.id AND ac.type = 1 AND ac.uid = #{uid} AND ac.is_deleted = 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_agree FROM t_img_detail AS i INNER JOIN t_follow AS fu ON fu.fid = i.user_id AND fu.uid = #{uid} AND fu.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN blade_user AS u ON i.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT air.mid, MIN(air.aid) AS aid FROM t_album_img_relation air WHERE air.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY air.mid ) AS air ON i.id = air.mid LEFT JOIN t_album AS a ON a.id = air.aid AND a.uid = i.user_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.status = 1 AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.update_time DESC LIMIT ${offset},${limit}
